title: aider_shim's four standing probes report to CodeMother's WATCHME gate
intention: aider_shim's four standing probes post their verdict against their own ticket's falsifier to CodeMother's watchme gate, and their specs name it as receiver.
why: 2026-11-12: a census of CairnCommons/tickets/*.state.json watchme found 132 probe specs, 100 with a receiver, 11 lacking; 4 of the 11 are live aider_shim probes on PROVED tickets (edit_survival_probe (6d3e689b0bf8), offload_yield_probe (d7b4019d2407), reflection_earns_its_ask (e9b0a8d4fb99), writes_to_is_where_it_landed_probe (68f1fc073512)), each PROBE with to='harbor_master' and verb ''. watch_carry (cairn/tools/base/probe.py:179) needs a 12-hex ticket id; the four TICKET constants are slugs.
traces_to: 835b5736bf2b (every probe has a receiver), its D2 (holds/finding against the probe's OWN ticket's falsifier); 386ea8131006 (the receiver is codemother machines/watchme/watch).
how: Each probe gains `_TICKET_ID` (its ticket's 12-hex id; the slug TICKET stays as the carry's ticket_path) and posts to='codemother', verb='machines/watchme/watch', carry=watch_carry(_TICKET_ID, _carry, holds=_holds). The predicate states the probe's own ticket's falsifier: reflection_earns_its_ask holds while falsifications(rows) is empty (its spec's stop-early observations); writes_to_is_where_it_landed_probe holds while no row reads landed-outside (its spec: the first outside drive is the finding); edit_survival_probe holds unless, once enough (5 recorded), rewritten+discarded outnumber survived (6d3e689b0bf8's wrong-intent tell); offload_yield_probe holds while counting, because its comparing column cc_calls is a declared hole per row (the openai_wire precedent: holds True, the horizon names a stall). Each spec gains receiver {what: 'codemother watchme gate', in: 'cairn/devices/codemother/machines/watchme'} through the artifact door. New proof cairn/devices/aider_shim/proofs/test_aider_probes_report_to_the_watchme_gate.py.

clauses.claim: each of the four aider_shim PROBEs (edit_survival_probe, offload_yield_probe, reflection_earns_its_ask, writes_to_is_where_it_landed_probe) posts to='codemother', verb='machines/watchme/watch', and its carry returns ticket = its own ticket's 12-hex id with a bool holds

each predicate reads False on its own falsifying rows and True on rows that do not falsify (reflection: a falsification; writes_to: a landed-outside row; edit_survival: rewritten+discarded above survived at enough; offload_yield: holds while cc_calls is a hole)
each of the four tickets' WATCHME spec carries receiver {what: 'codemother watchme gate', in: 'cairn/devices/codemother/machines/watchme'}

decisions.text: D1: each probe posts to the watchme gate through watch_carry with holds=_holds stated against its own ticket's falsifier; the slug TICKET stays in the carry and becomes ticket_path.
D2: each spec's receiver is written through the artifact door, the field and value 386ea8131006 settled.
D3: a new proof carries the three teeth; predicates are exercised by substituting the module's own reader (readings/dispositions/yields_so_far) with rows, then restoring it.
